title: How to Create an Invoice as a Freelancer
description: Step by step guide to creating a professional freelance invoice with what to include and best practices.
content:
What is a Freelance Invoice?

A freelance invoice is a bill you send to clients requesting payment for services rendered. A professional invoice helps you get paid faster and keeps your business organized.

What to Include on Your Invoice

  • Business name and contact details
  • Client name and contact details
  • Invoice number
  • Invoice date and due date
  • Itemized services with quantities and rates
  • Subtotal, taxes, discounts
  • Total amount due
  • Payment terms and methods

Steps to Create an Invoice

  1. Gather project details and hours worked
  2. List all services with clear descriptions
  3. Apply correct rates and calculate totals
  4. Add payment terms (e.g., Net 7, Net 30)
  5. Send the invoice and track it
